diagnoses.analysis: This is the aggregate required-status gate, not a separate build failure. Its frozen log runs exit 1. The exact-head check evidence identifies lint-check as the only failing prerequisite; .github/workflows/reusable-pr-build.yml explicitly fails this gate when needs.lint.result is not success. The same README formatting fix resolves the underlying cause. No gate weakening or rerun is needed.

The PR changed the Couchbase settings table and left noncanonical column alignment. CI-pinned rumdl 0.2.78 with the repository configuration reproduced exactly three MD060 errors at README lines 3-5. Running its focused formatter corrected only whitespace and separator widths in those three rows. The same Markdown check now passes for both changed Markdown files, formatting is idempotent, and all table cells and prose are unchanged.

metadata.body:
Couchbase 3.x operation spans now use `CLIENT`; known SDK detail spans are opt-in `INTERNAL` spans. Experimental attributes remain independently controlled, and Couchbase 3.0/3.1 use their non-javaagent scope names.

- **Configuration:** Set either option independently, or both to retain detail spans and experimental attributes:
  ```properties
  otel.instrumentation.couchbase.emit-experimental-telemetry=true
  otel.instrumentation.couchbase.experimental-span-attributes=true
  ```
  The second property continues to enable experimental attributes and remains a fallback for detail spans when the first property is unset.
- **Coverage:** Consolidate duplicate preview variants while retaining independent experimental-setting and Couchbase 3.2 dependency-version coverage.
metadata.title: Correct Couchbase 3.x span kinds and telemetry gates
